headline: Kalpataru Limited: Demerger
sum: Demerger — Kalpataru Limited has informed the Exchange about Order received from National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench Court III, Special Bench for approving the withdrawal of Scheme of Arrangement of Demerger of undertaking from…
detail: Demerger — Kalpataru Limited has informed the Exchange about Order received from National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench Court III, Special Bench for approving the withdrawal of Scheme of Arrangement of Demerger of undertaking from Kalpataru Properties Limited (formerly known as Kalpataru Properties Private Limited), a step down wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, into the Company
